doc: Where the vendored Ultrastable runtime shell (_shared/ultrastable-shell.css, .js, .json) came from. _shared/ultrastable-shell.test.mjs fails when the vendored bytes do not hash to content_hash, when this record and the contract disagree, or when an adopting worker holds a different copy. Refresh: copy brand/shell/artifact/ from ultrastable/ultrastable main, update commit and content_hash here, run node _shared/inline-ultrastable-shell.mjs qnfo-fleet-dashboard.
